observations: Photo 0 shows a sewing machine head/part with a red/black circular component and a red marking that appears to read “EM81”.
The image is close-up; key identification details (brand plate, full model name, motor specs) are not fully visible.
No clear view of needle area, feed mechanism, belt/direct-drive setup, or any working/test indicators.

claims.claim: Direct drive emel industrial sewing machine
claims.evidence: Photo 0 only shows a partial marking that looks like “EM81” but does not clearly show the brand/model “emel” or confirm direct-drive vs belt drive.

risks.risk: Drive type may not be direct drive (could be belt/other drive), which affects value and compatibility for the buyer.
risks.proof: A photo showing the motor-to-machine connection clearly (direct coupling vs belt/pulley) plus a short video of the machine running from start.
risks.if_unproven: Price as not confirmed direct-drive (worst case: treat as belt/unknown drive) until proven.

risks.risk: Model/brand may be misrepresented; “EM81” in the photo may not be the exact brand/model stated.
risks.proof: Clear photo of the machine’s nameplate/serial/model label (front/side of head) and the motor label (if separate).
risks.if_unproven: Price as generic industrial sewing machine with unknown model/brand.

risks.risk: Condition/workmanship unknown (may have timing/feed issues, noise, skipped stitches, or electrical faults).
risks.proof: Video sewing on fabric (showing feed, stitch formation, and consistent speed) and a photo of the bobbin area/needle area.
risks.if_unproven: Price as not working or untested until a sewing test is shown.

risks.risk: Missing accessories/parts (presser feet, bobbins, needles, power cable, motor controller) can reduce usability.
risks.proof: Photo list of included items laid out (feet, bobbins, needles, power cable, any controller/pedal) and what is missing.
risks.if_unproven: Price assuming essential accessories may be missing.

proof_requests: Clear photo of the nameplate/model/serial number on the machine head (not just the close-up marking).
Clear photo of the motor and how it connects to the machine (direct coupling vs belt/pulley).
Short video: start-up + sewing test on fabric (show stitch quality and feed).
Photos of included accessories (bobbin(s), presser feet, needles, power cable, pedal/controller if any).
response.reason: The photo does not clearly confirm the brand/model or direct-drive setup, and there is no working test evidence. Without these, a worst-case price cannot be set confidently.
